outgoing.name: Asia
outgoing.excerpt: In ancient times, large hyenas ranged over much of Europe and Asia, but they are much reduced in range and diversity today.

outgoing.name: Milk
outgoing.excerpt: Hyenas produce milk high in nutrients, so, unlike lions and wild dogs, they can leave their cubs for about a week without feeding them.
